purpose: Compare same-window grounded-QA distillation candidates across reference-overlap metrics, GPT-4o support judgments, and inherited support-oracle metrics.
source_cost_note: This synthesis makes no LLM calls. Some source systems were produced or judged by previously ledgered OpenAI calls.
comparability_note: Reference-overlap metrics, GPT-4o judge metrics, and support-oracle metrics answer different questions and should not be averaged together.

systems.label: Direct gpt-4o-mini student
systems.notes: Raw direct mini predictions before local citation-contract repair.

systems.label: Direct mini + citation repair
systems.notes: Zero-call local citation repair over direct mini outputs.

systems.label: Balanced claim-pruner-label risk gate
systems.notes: Zero-call local risk gate fitted on earlier claim-pruner labels and applied to repaired direct mini outputs.

systems.label: Mini-negative verifier teacher
systems.notes: Uses existing gpt-4o-mini negative judgments as a verifier signal; useful as a teacher, not as final amortized inference.

systems.label: Frozen sequence verifier (Strong support target)
systems.notes: Leave-window-out local sequence verifier trained on two judged windows and evaluated on 321-389.

systems.label: Frozen sequence verifier (Exported policy action)
systems.notes: Leave-window-out local sequence verifier trained on two judged windows and evaluated on 321-389.

systems.label: Temporal packet extractive scaffold
systems.notes: Zero-LLM local extractive scaffold trained only on the temporal SFT packet's 161-320 rows and evaluated on 321-389 prompts.

systems.label: Temporal answer-span scaffold
systems.notes: Zero-LLM local span selector trained from temporal SFT labels and evaluated on 321-389 prompts.

systems.label: Local Qwen 0.5B LoRA SFT (64 train rows)
systems.notes: Bounded local generative SFT diagnostic over compact prompts; no OpenAI calls and no hosted training.

systems.label: Local Qwen 0.5B LoRA SFT (answered-only)
systems.notes: Bounded local generative SFT diagnostic trained only on answered temporal labels to isolate answer-synthesis capability.

systems.label: Local Qwen 0.5B LoRA SFT (answered-only + citation repair)
systems.notes: Zero-call citation-contract repair over the answered-only local generative SFT diagnostic.

systems.label: Local Qwen 0.5B LoRA SFT (citation repair + contract gate)
systems.notes: Zero-call lexical evidence-overlap gate over repaired answered-only local SFT outputs.

conclusions: Direct mini plus citation repair remains the strongest answer-quality baseline on 321-389, but GPT-4o support correctness is only 72.5%.
The balanced local risk gate raises GPT-4o judged correctness to 79.7% and answer support to 70.5%, but reduces answered rows from 53 to 44 and lowers reference recall/F1.

The mini-negative verifier teacher reaches 82.6% support-oracle correctness with two useful and zero harmful suppressions on this window, making it a strong label-construction signal but not yet amortized because the source verifier uses mini calls.

Current learned/local verifier attempts fail to close that gap reliably; the best 321-389 sequence-verifier policy reaches 81.2% support-oracle correctness while the strong-support objective falls to 75.4%.
The temporal extractive scaffold is a weak zero-call floor: 31.9% answer rate, 6.1% answer F1, and 21.6% citation recall.

The temporal answer-span scaffold improves the extractive floor's answer rate and answer F1, but GPT-4o judges only 19.2% of answered spans supported because selected spans are often relevant text that does not answer the question.

The first bounded local Qwen LoRA SFT diagnostic is runnable but collapses to all abstentions on the final window, so the local generative path needs more training budget, better formatting, or a different backend before it can be a paper system.

Answered-only Qwen LoRA training proves the local model can emit some answers, but format and citation control remain weak: only 53.6% valid JSON, 22.2% inline citation compliance, and 21.8% citation precision.

A zero-call citation repair pass raises answered-only Qwen inline citation compliance to 100.0%, but it leaves answer F1 at 13.7%, citation precision at 21.8%, and citation recall at 13.1%, so it fixes format presentation rather than grounded correctness.

A zero-call lexical contract gate improves local-SFT citation precision to 33.3% by suppressing 26 of 36 generated answers, but answer F1 falls to 3.0% and citation recall to 6.3%; cheap overlap gating is therefore a precision diagnostic, not an amortized grounded-QA system.
